offer.stockAccounting: kP is event-charged; no synthetic initial stock or passive refill enabled

navigation.Casino: failure rolls BFi(1,2); 1 replaces token with kd[BFi(0,41)] + A0YE. BdL charges +1 extra. CKR conversion is 2*kP+j4.
navigation.RiskHedge: threshold 15+kc; paid failure adds kc+=15; success clears kc
navigation.ExchangeHouse: ordinary CJM outcome; its other navigation effects are separate

successBonusActualMeaning: CRl manual random-unit reroll, normally consumes one h06G; RiskHedge waives token. Not an attack buff.
